parsed.side_detail: Person 1 was ahead and to my right but drifting toward my left, so I moved further left to open up the gap on the side away from her path; the left wall also kept me out of the wider space she was moving into.

utterances.message: Sorry, coming through — go ahead, I'll keep left.
